description: As a Nordwerk client I want to see the company name and main statement in the header so that I can identify the business quickly

acceptance_criteria.description: Company name 'Nordwerk Industrie-Service' and main statement 'Praktische Unterstützung für Ihren technischen Betrieb.' are visible within the first viewport
No additional content blocks or navigation elements interfere with the header visibility

description: As a client I want all three services with their descriptions to be clearly listed so that I can understand the services offered

acceptance_criteria.description: Three services: 'Wartungsplanung', 'Ersatzteilkoordination', and 'Betriebsdokumentation' with their respective descriptions are present
Service descriptions match the exact required content N-03, N-04, N-05 without any modifications

description: As a client I want to see the target groups and working approach section so that I can understand who the services are for and how they work

acceptance_criteria.description: Target groups: 'Kleine Produktionsbetriebe' and 'Technische Serviceunternehmen' are listed
Working approach description: 'Ein fester Ansprechpartner, ein gemeinsam vereinbarter Leistungsumfang und nachvollziehbare Ergebnisse.' is present

description: As a client I want a contact link that allows me to send an email request and see the course notice so that I can understand the project's nature

acceptance_criteria.description: Contact link text 'Anfrage stellen' targets mailto:kontakt@nordwerk.example
Course notice 'Fiktives Unternehmen – Lehrprojekt der HAW Hamburg. Keine realen Angebote oder Kontaktaufnahme.' is visible in the footer
